title: Migration 38 — farmer-photos object policies
description: Applies migration 37 then 38, runs 38's VERIFY A-C, then rolls back 38 on a disposable PostgreSQL 18 cluster. 38 is split from 37 because CREATE POLICY on storage.objects requires OWNERSHIP, which the production SQL Editor's postgres role does not hold (storage.objects is owned by supabase_admin) -- while a bucket write needs only table privileges. 38 declares 37 as a precondition and refuses if the farmer-photos bucket is absent or public: installing object policies on a public bucket would create the appearance of access control without the substance. Rolling 38 back leaves the bucket and its objects untouched; only access is removed, fail-closed.

verify.note: A asserts presence AND shape -- a policy that exists but omits the role check, or whose upload check is not prefix-bound, would satisfy a naive count while leaving the bucket open. B asserts RLS is on. C is INFORMATIONAL and emits no PASSED token: it reports migration 22's overlay, which 38 does not install. Read-only throughout; safe against Production whole.
